author: GitHub
description:
Want to contribute to open source but don't know where to start? The "good first issue" label is your open invitation from project maintainers. You can even use GitHub Copilot to find projects in your favorite programming language that match this exact label. Pick a project, read the contributing guide, and make your first small fix today. For more tips, check out GitHub for beginners season 3 on our channel.
